clauses.text: "You" means only the policyholder listed on the declarations page; a spouse or permanent partner is not included even when living in the same home.
"Personal injury" means harm to a person's health caused by an accident, such as wounds or illness; it does not include death.
This section does not cover damage to things you have rented or are looking after for someone else; things you borrowed are covered.
This section does not cover using any vehicle that a family member owns, whether or not it is listed on the declarations page.

clauses.part: Personal accident cover for the driver
clauses.text: Autos Poblado pays the personal accident insured value only if the authorized driver dies because of a traffic accident. Permanent disability is not covered.

clauses.part: Loss of the vehicle by damage and by theft
clauses.text: This section does not cover damage that happens while the vehicle is carrying people or goods, whether for pay or among friends splitting the cost of a trip.

clauses.part: Loss of the vehicle by damage and by theft
clauses.text: This section does not cover wear from use, rust or lack of maintenance; mechanical and electrical failures are covered.
Tell us about any loss event within 30 days; after that, the notice is no longer accepted.
